title: Wallets Africa is now Spring in Africa
body_markdown:
When I founded Wallet.ng, I aimed to create a digital wallet for daily payments in Nigeria, combining web efficiency like PayPal and offline ubiquity like mobile banking apps.


After Y Combinator, we rebranded to Wallets Africa for expansion in Ghana, Kenya, and Cote d’Ivoire. Excited to announce our parent organization’s new name, Spring in Africa.


Even though we are no longer offering prepaid cards, Spring represents a reset, refresh, and expansion, evolving from a naira wallet to offering multiple financial services. All subsidiaries are now under Spring, powered by our payments software, Wallets.


Stay tuned for updates in our communications via email, social media, websites, and through partners. Thank you.
